title: Randolph AFB 'accelerated learning' Skinner box program
place_text: Randolph Air Force Base, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: they said to the parents that it was an accelerated learning program with for children with very very high IQs

plain: In 1952 at Randolph Air Force Base in San Antonio, Texas, children were reportedly put through a program built around Skinner boxes, the closed boxes psychologists used to train behaviour with rewards and punishments. The writer Whitley Strieber passes this on from what he was told, and says the parents heard it was "an accelerated learning program" for children "with very very high IQs", which would mean the military was running secret experiments on gifted children under a harmless-sounding name.
